heading: Your information, handled with care.

sections.title: Browser tools
sections.body: The prompt generator, image resizer, and invoice generator process input in your browser. This implementation does not upload tool inputs or save them to a database.

sections.title: Booking and external links
sections.body: When a scheduling provider is connected, its own privacy policy and data handling apply. External websites linked from this site may have different practices.

sections.title: Hosting and contact
sections.body: The hosting platform may process technical request information to deliver the site. Business contact details and any final inquiry provider must be added before public launch.
